125369: An underground Megaloboxer from the outskirts of town whose real name is unknown, Junk Dog is forced to throw fights to earn money for his crooked manager, Gansaku Nanbu. He had something that most boxers lack however: ''A True Fighting Spirit''.
127574: Yuuri is Yukiko Shirato's bodyguard and the current champion of Megalolania, a massive megaloboxing tournament headed by the Shirato Group.
130053: Head of the Shirato Group who oversees the Megalonia tournament.
130054: A young boy from the impoverished Restricted Area who is talented with using and fixing machinery, which he and his friends often use to steal goods which they exchange for "Red Candy", a type of drug.
130055: A mob boss that sets up fixed fights for Junk Dog and Nanbu. He assists the duo in acquiring a forged Citizen ID so they can enter Megalonia and pay him back with the prize money after Junk Dog refuses to throw a fight.
130056: Gansaku Nanbu is Joe's boxing coach and manager. He is a known gambler with a drinking problem. He and Joe used to work in the underground boxing scene, making Joe throw fixed fights to earn cash.
130057: Yukiko's older brother and the developer of Ace, a state-of-the-art Gear equipped with artificial intelligence that allows it to read and predict an opponent's moves, formulating the perfect counters and strategies.
130058: Nanbu's former student. He was called up for military service a few years before the start of the story, during his time as a soldier he was directly hit by an explosion which cost him his legs and burned half his face off.
173539: Oicho is one of Sachio's friends and an engineer who is apprenticing under Abuhachi and helps out at the shop.
173540: A Megalo boxer who fights in a rigged match against Junk Dog.
216685: Chief is a Megaloboxer who lives in a community of immigrants called the Casa. His career is relegated to the lower rings. His warm personality has made him a leader of sorts in the Casa group.
217862: Mara is a tough woman who runs the maintenance factory in the Casa and raises Mio on her own. She’s so reliable that she helps Chief out with everything, from maintaining his gears to assisting in his daily life.
217863: Mio is Marla’s only son. He hangs out with the wrong crowd, which is constantly getting him into trouble. He even steals Joe’s motorcycle.
225451: Mac was never a great Megaloboxer, and suffered from a life-threatening injury in the line of duty when he became a police officer to help his family.
274800: A high-ranking Mexican Megaloboxer and contestant in Megalonia.
